content: Guest {{userName}} will be moved to the {{membersSection}} section and assigned the '{{ secondType }}' type. {{productName}} admins can access settings, manage and archive rooms, invite new users and assign roles below their level. {{productName}} admins have access to the {{documentsSection}} section.

comment.text: Descriptive text in the ChangeUserTypeDialog explaining the consequences of upgrading a guest to an Admin. It uses `<strong>` tags for emphasis and includes variables for the username, section names, new role type, and product name.
